name: Okusaano Shoun
original_name: オクサーノ・ショーン
source:
The wife of the ski lodge owner. A friendly and caring woman.
She serves the lodge's specialty cake, the Piropippi Uddo Cake.

[From [url=https://promo.shonenjump.com/spyfamily/14cp/doorway/]official site[/url]]
